name: Tasha Monroe

five_sec.what_is_it: I don't know. A lady and a little girl laughing. 'Less Stress, More Dinners.'
five_sec.trust_why: It's a video. Doesn't say what it is or what it costs.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Pictures of food all around a phone. Could be they send it.

full_page.what_stopped_me: 'Try Free for 14 Days.' Then what? No price on the whole page. And a pop-up asking for my email.
full_page.whats_missing: The price. I did see Aldi, Meijer and Walmart in the logos, that part's good.

EM.quote: 'Try Free for 14 Days.' Then what? I scrolled the whole thing, no price. I'm not paying for that.

five_sec.what_is_it: An app for recipes and grocery lists.
five_sec.who_for: People who like to plan. Not me.
five_sec.trust_why: It says no card. The stars look OK.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's app store buttons and somebody writing in a notebook.

full_page.what_stopped_me: $5.95 a month after two weeks. And I gotta bring my own recipes.
full_page.whats_missing: Something free. Something simple enough for my son to cook from.

PTE.quote: No card is nice. But it's $5.95 after two weeks and I gotta bring my own recipes. My son needs simple directions, not a recipe book.

five_sec.trust_why: Open a box to see my offer, like a scratch-off.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: The HelloFresh boxes. They mail you food.

full_page.what_stopped_me: No price unless I give my zip code. Small print at the bottom.

HF.quote: Open a box for my offer like it's a scratch-off. 'Free Breakfast for Life.' Nothing's free for life. Not paying for that.

five_sec.trust_why: The big orange button says 'Letter from the CEO.' I don't want a letter.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Picture of a bowl of food on a phone. Can't tell.

full_page.what_stopped_me: $25 a month. $100 a month. And they count your messages.

OL.quote: $25 a month and they count my messages? $100 for 'Always-On'? That's my light bill.

five_sec.what_is_it: It plans dinner and puts the grocery list in Instacart or Walmart. Texts the family.
five_sec.trust_why: It says no card. It says Walmart. But 'Powered by Instacart' up top, and Instacart fees are why I'm mad.
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It says 'We don't deliver food.' Plain as day.

full_page.what_stopped_me: Two prices. '$0 forever' and then '14 days free' and '$4.99/mo' right next to it. Which one am I on? And it's long, I read it on my lunch.
full_page.whats_missing: Meijer. What Walmart charges me for delivery since I don't have a car. I liked that it says why it's free: Instacart pays them.

DD.quote: It says $0 forever, OK. Then right under it, 14 days free and $4.99. Which one am I getting? And Instacart still gets their fees off me.

dd_offer.why: I see 'no card.' But I see 'free for 14 days' and that's what they all say before they charge you.
dd_offer.expect_day_15: It wants $4.99 or it stops working. Maybe the free part keeps going, I don't know. I'd ask my neighbor.

head_to_head.reason: Only one that says $0 and Walmart, and tells me why it's free.

EM.reason: DinnerDrop shows a price. eMeals doesn't.

PTE.reason: Free, and it picks the dinners.

HF.reason: A list for Walmart instead of a box I can't afford.

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page first screen: say 'Free. $0. No card. Works with Walmart.' first and on its own, and move the '14 days of Family / $4.99' line lower down with 'you stay on the free plan after day 14, nothing is charged' in the same sentence.
